task.description: Design and add the test coverage for OBS-01. Write the requirement test spec at tests/specs/OBS-01.md and add the necessary unit and integration tests for structured JSON log shape, BPM_LOG_LEVEL validation, sensitive-field redaction, request trace propagation, and background-task trace generation. Prefer deterministic tests and avoid wall-clock or random dependencies without fixed control points. Complete the handoff with produced artifacts and any issues.
acceptance_criteria: OBS-01 has a test spec before new test code
At least one automated test covers each OBS-01 MUST acceptance criterion
Tests cover invalid BPM_LOG_LEVEL handling, redaction, and trace_id behavior
No new test depends on uncontrolled wall-clock time or random values

result.summary: Added OBS-01 test design and deterministic backend coverage for structured log shape, invalid BPM_LOG_LEVEL validation, sensitive-field redaction, request trace propagation, and background trace generation.
